purpose: Pre-register what the first prospective V8.13+ selected sample can and cannot establish before observing it.

allowed: run selected-generation classifier per selected row
forbidden: claim economic superiority from same-day plan geometry
use immature D1/D3/D5 as completed outcomes

maturity.D1: only after one subsequent trading day closes
maturity.D3: only after three subsequent trading days close
maturity.D5: only after five subsequent trading days close
maturity.MFE_MAE: same horizon maturity; no future bars
maturity.economicComparisonMinimum: multiple independent scan dates; date-cluster/LODO and costs required before optimization candidacy

provenance.nonSelectedShadow: remains generation-guarded for cross-store sizing attribution

antiCherryPick: report every eligible scan date including zero-selection
do not change maturity horizon after seeing results
